skills.title: Intern/Thesis/Working Student (f/m/d) - Evaluating and Improving LLM-based SE Solutions in SAP HANA
skills.job_description:
We help the world run better
At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.
What you'll build
Large language model (LLM) have a huge impact on software engineering. The context of SAP HANA is rather unique: A software project with over 10 million lines code, but not contained in the training data of any public LLM. We found that many results from public research about LLM usage in software engineering do not translate to SAP HANA.
This student position supports an internal research project driven by a PhD to evaluate the usefulness of LLM in the context of SAP HANA. The goal is the determine concrete recommendations of how to apply LLM in the context of SAP HANA for various tasks.
Some example tasks: Test generation, fault localization, LLM-as-a-judge, software reliability engineering, incident analysis, health checks, software engineering task automation, code reviews, static code analysis automation, bug fix automation, bug fix analysis, performance analysis and improvements, cost optimization, test flakiness improvements, benchmarking.
The student will have access to recent LLM models and also to GPU-based hardware for executing ML workloads (inferencing, learning, and so on).
We support both thesis and working student positions, details will be discussed and aligned in a first interview.
What you bring
Expected qualifications:
Student of computer science, data science, computer linguistics, mathematics or related field at a higher education institution
Experience with programming, machine learning and LLMs, demonstrated by existing projects.
A solid foundation of machine learning and statistics, and of practical application of LLM
Comfortable with English for daily communication (B level). German (B level) is a plus.
Very good grades shown by a Transcript of Records (ToR) / Grades
The application must contain (English or German):
A cover letter showing your interest
A CV that provides information about your programming experience
A transcript of records (ToR) that contains grades of all university-level courses/degrees
This is not a remote position, working in Walldorf expected, some home office days can be negotiated.
Where you belong
The HANA organization develops SAP HANA. Our team contributes to software engineering research for this organization, to development of AI-based tools for software engineering, and towards processes and delivery of HANA.

skills.title: Working Student (f/m/d) - Compliance Document Publication & Distribution
skills.job_description:
We help the world run better
At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.
What you'll build
Security compliance is what lets thousands of organizations trust SAP with their most critical operations. Our team, Compliance Technology & Distribution (CTD), builds and runs the services that make that trust visible: from automated audit management to the tools that put SAP's compliance certificates directly into customers' workflows.
As a working student, you'll contribute to the day-to-day operations of our Compliance Offering Distribution (COD) service, improve the processes around it, and coordinate across teams to keep things running. This is real, consequential work: compliance documents that don't reach customers on time create genuine business problems, and you'll help make sure they don't.
You'll also be close to a meaningful shift in how compliance works. Driven by new regulations like NIS2, DORA, and the AI Act, we're building toward continuous, AI-powered and API-driven compliance automation. You'll see that evolution from the inside and contribute to it.
What you'll do day-to-day:
Support compliance document distribution operations: tracking requests, coordinating delivery, and improving service quality
Identify process gaps and help fix them: propose improvements, document outcomes, follow through
Coordinate with audit, product, and service partner teams to keep workflows aligned
Maintain service documentation and operational reporting
Engage with AI-assisted compliance automation tooling and contribute to how we develop it further
What you bring
Student (f/m/d) Enrolled in a degree program in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Information Systems, or something similar
Comfortable with Microsoft 365 (Excel, SharePoint, Teams); experience with ticketing or service management tools is a plus
Fluent in English. This is our working language; German is welcome but not a requirement
You like working in a team, can drive tasks independently to completion, and don't wait to be told what to do
Scripting or programming experience is a plus; so is any prior work experience
Working from the Walldorf office is not required. Hybrid is welcome.
Where you belong
